title: Layer 5: Wild Signals
title_zh: 第五层：草蛇灰线——意外信号
desc: Grassroots clues — more reliable than headlines
desc_zh: 这些不在头条里，但比任何高级指标都准

mbsItinerary.value: Beijing Apr 2026. Stayed in Saudi during Hormuz crisis. Next: ?
mbsItinerary.value_zh: 2026年4月访京。霍尔木兹危机期间留守沙特。下一站：？
mbsItinerary.threshold: More Beijing than DC visits = strategic drift
mbsItinerary.threshold_zh: 去北京多于华盛顿=战略偏移
mbsItinerary.note: MBS has not traveled abroad since Hormuz crisis escalation. Stayed in Saudi for Hajj 2026 season. No new foreign trip reported. Notably, MBS did not attend any international summits during Jun 28-Jul 5 period. Continued to chair Saudi Cabinet in Riyadh. Updated 2026-07-05
mbsItinerary.note_zh: MBS留守沙特，未出访。霍尔木兹危机期间未参加任何国际峰会。继续在利雅得主持沙特内阁。更新于 2026-07-05

singaporeStance.value: Officially neutral, adjusting quietly — AI hub role growing
singaporeStance.value_zh: 官方中立，暗中调整——AI枢纽角色增长
singaporeStance.threshold: Singapore picks a side = every other Asian ally is already doing it
singaporeStance.threshold_zh: 新加坡选边=其他亚洲盟友已经在做了
singaporeStance.note: Both US and Chinese AI firms setting up shop in Singapore as 'Asia's neutral AI hub' (Fortune, Jun 19). No policy stance shift yet. Singapore continues neutral posture as US-Iran tensions shift to diplomacy. Updated 2026-07-05
singaporeStance.note_zh: 中美AI企业均在狮城设点，新加坡为'亚洲中立AI枢纽'（财富，6月19日）。政策立场未变。美伊关系转向外交轨道过程中新加坡保持中立。更新于 2026-07-05

adbLoanCurrency.threshold: Meaningful increase (>2%) = multilateral acceptance of RMB
adbLoanCurrency.threshold_zh: 显著增长(>2%)=多边机构对RMB的实质接受
adbLoanCurrency.note: ADB annual report still pending. EU Trade Chief met China's Commerce Minister in Brussels Jun 29 — trade finance implications for RMB loans. No new ADB data observed this cycle. Checked 2026-07-05
adbLoanCurrency.note_zh: 亚行年报仍未发布。欧盟贸易代表6月29日与中商务部长布鲁塞尔会晤——贸易金融影响RMB贷款。本周期无亚行新数据。核实于 2026-07-05

hkmaInterventions.threshold: Sustained weak-side touches = capital outflow pressure from Asia
hkmaInterventions.threshold_zh: 持续触碰弱方=亚洲资本外流压力
hkmaInterventions.note: No major HKMA intervention reported this cycle. Gulf capital flight to safe havens may affect HKD peg but no evidence of sustained weak-side touches yet. Monitor for capital flow changes as Hormuz situation shifts to diplomacy. Updated 2026-07-05
hkmaInterventions.note_zh: 本周未报告金管局重大干预。海湾资本逃向避险资产或影响港币联系汇率，但暂无持续弱方兑换触发证据。霍尔木兹转向外交轨道后监测资本流向变化。更新于 2026-07-05

chinaGoldImportPath.value: Hong Kong/Dubai route surging; direct Russia unclear
chinaGoldImportPath.value_zh: 香港/迪拜路线激增；对俄直购不明
chinaGoldImportPath.threshold: Route change = settlement system de-dollarization in motion
chinaGoldImportPath.threshold_zh: 路径改变=结算体系去美元化在进行
chinaGoldImportPath.note: China's gold imports rise to highest in more than 2 years, up 76% YTD (Seeking Alpha, Jun 24). World Gold Council: Central Bank Gold Buying Hits Second-Highest Monthly Total in May 2026 (Yesterday). Hong Kong/Dubai route surging (SCMP, May 4). Iran's envoy to China says Beijing to get Hormuz concessions — potential gold-for-oil settlement mechanism. No confirmed direct Russia route. China ramps up Hong Kong gold hub efforts (KITCO, Mar). Updated 2026-07-05
chinaGoldImportPath.note_zh: 中国黄金进口创两年多新高，YTD增长76%（Seeking Alpha，6月24日）。世界黄金协会：2026年5月央行购金创历史第二高月度总量（昨日）。香港/迪拜路线激增（南华早报，5月4日）。伊朗驻华大使称北京将获海峡权益——或为黄金换石油结算机制铺垫。无确认的对俄直购路径。中国加速建设香港黄金枢纽。更新于 2026-07-05

pewFavorability.value_zh: 美国约49% · 中国约36%（2025年，25国中位数）
pewFavorability.threshold: US declining across allies; China stable-low but improving in Global South
pewFavorability.threshold_zh: 美国在盟友中好感度持续下降；中国稳定偏低但在全球南方改善
pewFavorability.note: Pew surveyed 35 countries in 2024 and 25 in spring 2025. US median favorable fell from 54% to ~49%. China rose from 35% to ~36%. No new Pew data published this cycle. Checked 2026-07-05
pewFavorability.note_zh: 皮尤2024年调查35国、2025年春季调查25国。美国好感度中位数从54%降至约49%。中国从35%升至约36%。本周期无新皮尤数据。核实于 2026-07-05
